doc.title: Danny Barker Interview (Louis Armstrong memorial broadcast), 1971-07-09

title: Armstrong cannot be figured out; his temper and the dozens
summary: Barker says there is only one Armstrong, ranks him above Caruso, Edison and Ford, recalls his temper and mastery of the dozens, and the interview closes.
